name: violencetown
description: A browser-based 2D action-RPG of small violences — zero-dependency vanilla JavaScript on HTML5 Canvas, no build step, installable as a PWA.
author: Caelan Gander

scripts.map:audit: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('game').filter(n=>n.endsWith('-map.json'))) require('child_process').execSync(`node tools/map-audit.mjs game/${f}`,{stdio:'inherit'})"
